description: Defines abstract classes and interfaces for managing vertex buffers in a graphics API-agnostic manner, specifically for Direct3D rendering within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: VertexBuffer
classes.description: Abstract class for managing GPU vertex buffer objects with reference counting and serial tracking.

classes.name: VertexBufferInterface
classes.description: Base class for vertex buffer interfaces, managing buffer size, serial, and buffer access.

classes.name: StreamingVertexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for managing dynamic, streaming vertex buffers.

classes.name: StaticVertexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for managing static, unchanging vertex buffers with attribute matching.

classes.name: AttributeSignature
classes.description: Helper class for matching and setting vertex attribute signatures in static buffers.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the vertex buffer with specified size and usage.

methods.name: storeVertexAttributes
methods.description: Stores vertex attribute data into the buffer.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the buffer.

methods.name: getSpaceRequired
methods.description: Calculates space needed for vertex attributes.

methods.name: storeDynamicAttribute
methods.description: Stores dynamic attribute data into a streaming buffer.

methods.name: reserveVertexSpace
methods.description: Reserves space for vertex data in a streaming buffer.

methods.name: storeStaticAttribute
methods.description: Stores static attribute data into a static buffer.

methods.name: matchesAttribute
methods.description: Checks if the static buffer matches a given attribute and binding.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets the attribute and binding for the static buffer.
